purpose: Redesign cave art around the original flat cyan Spine hero. Two environment mood concepts.

inputs.role: Read-only original outline and color inspection
Generation reference 1: assembled original hero identity
Generation reference 2: loose side-view cave composition, not texture style

artContract.seams: No seamless tile or WFC socket claim
artContract.shapePrecision: Broad readable slopes, platform tops and foreground rock masses. No exact geometry or collision claim.
artContract.hero: Preserve oversized round cyan hood, cream face, small stick-like limbs and simple ink features. AI depiction is not a byte-exact sprite composite.
artContract.style: Clean broad flat fills, slightly irregular dark contours, sparse grouped cracks, two or three value levels, receding background silhouettes
artContract.rationale: Large scene style exploration benefits from built-in image generation; this does not produce low-resolution pixel tiles.
artContract.preservation: Original Spine, original PNGs, other chat candidates and Game remain unchanged.
